description: Historical raw synthetic assistant measurements; original run HEAD/blobs/environment retained. No rerun or new speedup claim during roadmap closure. SQL count is Prisma events and JSON bytes are returned result serialization, not wire traffic.

versions.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

s3Before.methodology: Sequential current action.prepare inside campaign-locked scoped transaction; no executor/auth/intent writes. queryCount: owned Prisma query events, including transaction/lock statements. resultJsonBytes: sum of UTF-8 JSON sizes of returned model/raw query results, NOT PostgreSQL network traffic. serializeMs: separately timed harness result serialization included in elapsedMs. elapsedMs: entire transaction call including commit and instrumentation. prepare is read-only: seed/size checks/source diff/cleanup/migration reads are outside measured intervals. Fixed logical rows/IDs/clock across runs via same explicit marker. transactionMs, lock wait/duration, snapshot/hash CPU and PostgreSQL wire bytes unavailable.
